question: How do I sign out of Viva Engage in the Collaboration Center?
reference:
To log out from Viva Engage in the Collaboration Center, follow this procedure:

Open the Collaboration Center in your web browser.
In the left menu, select Viva Engage (if it is not already selected).
In the bottom-right corner of the Viva Engage page, click Sign Out.
In the new browser window, on the Microsoft Sign Out page, select the account you want to sign out from.
Complete the sign-out process when prompted.
After these steps, you are logged out of Viva Engage in the Collaboration Center and returned to the Collaboration Center page, where the Sign In button is displayed.
